patch.description: Owner-authorized PROPERTY_EDIT operation, audit and scoped idempotency commit atomically. Stable code/name/aliases are unique per workspace. Features/services use availability rather than physical quantities. Changes preserve immutable historical definitions; retiring does not delete records or change supplied inventory. Current ETag required for update.

destination.description: Indian mobile in +91 format or supported ASCII email. Email domain is lowercased; local part is case-sensitive. No automatic account linking.

unreadCount.description: All unread notices owned by the current account, not just this page.

status.description: Expired when deadline passes, including before the worker persists expiry. Worker commits expired state and version with an authorized owner notice; no membership/capacity allocation. Concurrent stale commands return 412 or unavailable commands 409.

replacesInvitationId.description: Previous expired invitation in this workspace, if this is an explicit replacement.

email.description: Email identity rules: ASCII local-part spelling preserved; domain normalized to lowercase.

lastCode.description: QUIET_HOURS_DEFERRED means shared notice is available and the optional personal copy is pending. nextAttemptAt is the next policy recheck; quiet waits do not consume cycleAttempts.

ManagerReconciliation.description: Owner-only current snapshot evidence. Sandbox acceptance commits reservation and consumption together, so persisted manager reservations are unexplained. Counts do not authorize repairs.

channel.description: Omitted by older email-link clients; defaults to email. Only the missing contact can be added.

outcomeToken.description: Memory-only scoped read grant. Do not log or put in a URL; cannot authenticate or repeat recovery.

quietHoursEnabled.description: Defer optional workspace setup personal copies during the configured Asia/Kolkata interval.

ChangeNotificationPreferences.description: Quiet-hour fields must be supplied together, with distinct HH:mm times. Omitting all three preserves the existing quiet policy for older clients. Start inclusive/end exclusive; overnight intervals supported; Asia/Kolkata.

localContainers.description: True only for sandbox delivery to local Mailpit and SMS simulator containers.

retry.description: Current reads include retry policy; historical idempotency responses may omit it. Refresh for current eligibility.

settlement.description: Durable received-payment evidence and activation recovery. Absent in old idempotency responses; refresh for current state.

cancellation.description: Immutable cancellation-specific policy. Null or absent for legacy downgrade reviews.

refundAmount.description: Null when no actual monetary settlement applies. Never a synthetic refund or credit.

creditAmount.description: Null when no actual monetary settlement applies. Never a synthetic refund or credit.

EffectiveQuota.description: Workspace-scoped counters under an immutable bound counting policy. New sandbox workspaces count independently rentable whole units and beds once, shared containers zero. Existing workspaces retain their prior policy. Draft/ready/maintenance-blocked count; archived does not. Occupants and tenancies never multiply inventory. Weighted combinations are unsupported. Owner projection reconciles inventory and evidence; remaining is null when unassessed or inconsistent.
